28 web searches used. Every page fetch (plasticker.de, plastech.pl, businessanalytiq.com) failed on DNS from this sandbox; all figures were read from search-engine extracts of the cited pages. Several businessanalytiq extracts carry a '324 days ago' crawl tag beside a 'September 2026' header — the month label is the page's own, but treat as moderate confidence.

Glass/mineral compounds have no public European price series (PIE / KI / ICIS compound reports are paywalled; Ultramid, Tarnamid are quote-only). Instead this file gives DERIVED raw-material floors (resin share × resin price + glass share × glass fibre price) so obvious book errors can be caught; a floor is not a price.

Book figures that look wrong: mat-pc-abs 9.49 is below the resin content of its own blend (70/30 = 10.50; even 50/50 = 9.79) — too low. mat-cf-dry-3k 124.57 (3K woven fabric) is below the generic 12K carbon-fibre price 130.87 (IMARC Germany Mar 2026) — too low. mat-pom 10.13 is ~13% below the market index 11.70 (businessanalytiq Jul 2026), which agrees with round 1's Plastech 11.65.

Book figures that look high but are unconfirmed: mat-pp-gf30 9.13 (1.9× the 4.76 floor); mat-mb-black 11.02 (1.8× the 6.15 floor). Plausible against floors: mat-pa66gf30 15.32 (+22%), mat-pbt-gf30 15.32 (+37%), mat-pps-gf40 27.83 (+28%), mat-mb-white-tio2 16.26.

Not found: any market price for PA66-GF30, PA6-GF30, PP-GF30, PP-T20, PC/ABS, PBT-GF30, TPU, TPE-S, TPV; all sheet/semi-finished prices; EPDM/NBR/HCR rubber COMPOUND prices; masterbatch prices; polyester powder coating; e-coat; epoxy prepreg (only an unattributed market-report range).
